svg.text: Riser hanger: keep the whole floor depth in the comparison
31 October 2026 / unadopted B plan / mm / manufacturer geometry plus a conditional datum comparison
A Hold slab top +3320 and ceiling top +3115
150 slab
55 gross remaining
soffit +3170
175 slab
30 gross remaining
soffit +3145
200 slab
5 gross remaining
soffit +3120
Remaining depth precedes actual hanger, protection and tolerances.
No hanger section is drawn: its installed downstand is unbound.
B Keep the original 55 service reservation instead
150 / 175 / 200 slabs give ceiling undersides +3100 / +3075 / +3050.
Those are gross datums before further hanger or protection depth.
The 200 case spends 50 mm; it requires an explicit section rewind.
C A named product brings real constraints
Grey: slab / green: unallocated depth / ochre: 15 ceiling.
PETRA standard symmetric depths start at 175; HC150 is unbound.
200 is the first shared listed depth with the cited Ibstock range.
This is a comparison opportunity, not approved compatibility.
Page 22 illustrates 55 overlap on a sound receiving edge.
Neither figure turns the old 100 tail sensitivity into a bearing.
For depths ≤200: joint 50–70; supported bearing maximum 80.
Fire-rebar arrangement: slab face at least 51 past opening edge.
At x = 10070 this gives x = 10121, before further allowance.
The resulting 1476.5 to the outer structural face is not a cut length.
D Retain separate load and closure duties
Receiving slabs need their own concentrated-reaction check.
Direct cabinet or closure point/line loads require individual design.
The service zone is not a sealed opening or a cabinet support.
Keep the permanent trim distinct from renewable service faces.
Continue the HC150 supplier enquiry or redraw the complete section; retain the independent frame alternative.
Source: PETRA PEIKKO GROUP 04/2025, pp 6–11, 14, 21–22; Ibstock nominal depths, accessed 31 October 2026.
No resistance, chosen hanger, manufacturing approval, firestop, material exception or STR-HOUSE completion is established.
Reproduce with house-riser-trim.mjs; source-bound product/depth record: house-riser-product.json.
